provenance: Original published 2025 crop from the measured AA6016 T4 study; no source arrays modified. This is not the entire experimental volume or loading series.

files.processing: Author-published crop retained unchanged; example imports LabDCT only and leaves AbsorptionCT unread.

catalogue_discrepancy: The catalogue/tutorial state all grains have at least 27 voxels. The actual download contains grain 1049 with 23 voxels touching a crop face. The example preserves and flags it; historical cause is not established by the file.
packaging_status: Not added to normal data installation. Track the original 567,693,056-byte file for later dataset/pipeline approval; a lossless smaller runtime derivative is a separate packaging decision.
